title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. translated_title: NaviGATE：面向多模态知识图谱推理的噪声感知双视角生成方法
translated_abstract: 多模态知识图谱推理（MKGR）旨在通过联合利用关系结构、文本描述和视觉证据来推断缺失的事实。现有的基于嵌入的方法能够有效捕获图拓扑结构，但其固定的多模态表示在面向特定查询的细粒度语义推理方面效果欠佳；而基于生成的方法则容易受到噪声检索的影响，并可能生成无效实体。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了NaviGATE，一个面向多模态知识图谱推理的噪声感知生成框架。NaviGATE首先将源自图的结构表示与文本语义进行对齐，随后通过利用多模态实体摘要和注入的结构标记对多模态语言模型进行微调，实现结构感知的内部知识激活。在噪声感知的双视角指令微调阶段，NaviGATE联合优化无检索视角与检索感知视角：可靠的检索候选……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: NaviGATE提出了一种噪声感知的双视角生成框架，通过将图结构表示与文本语义对齐、激活多模态语言模型的内部知识，并联合优化无检索与检索感知两种视角，有效提升了多模态知识图谱推理在噪声环境下的准确性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: NaviGATE introduces a noise-aware dual-view generative framework for multimodal knowledge graph reasoning, which aligns graph structural representations with textual semantics, activates internal knowledge of multimodal language models, and jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views to improve accuracy and robustness under noisy retrieval.
